_about: The music under the explainer: which track, where it's cropped, and how loud. Until a track is chosen (file: null) the soundtrack is the voice alone. To add one: put it in video/music/, set file, artist, title, bpm, and the drop (drop.track: seconds into the track of a strong downbeat; drop.video: where it should land in the video), then set BEAT_GRID in stage.js to { bpm, at: drop.video } so every cut lands on the beat. Levels are gains in dB on the track: low under the voice, mid under a line spoken over a title card, high on a title card while nobody speaks.
